export const OWN_PLUGIN = 'lumberroom-memory'
files..claude-plugin/plugin.json:
{
  "name": "lumberroom-memory",
  "displayName": "lumberroom memory",
  "version": "0.5.1",
  "description": "lumberroom as Claude Code's memory: the digest in the system prompt, a periodic search-and-write reminder, optional per-prompt recall, built-in memory off.",
  "author": {
    "name": "the-cybersapien"
  },
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "repository": "https://github.com/lumberroom/lumberroom-claude-code",
  "homepage": "https://lumberroom.cloud",
  "icon": "./assets/icon.png",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/lumberroom/lumberroom-claude-code#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/lumberroom/lumberroom-claude-code/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://lumberroom.cloud/privacy",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://lumberroom.cloud/terms",
  "keywords": [
    "memory",
    "mcp",
    "lumberroom",
    "context"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "project": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project",
      "description": "auto takes the git root's folder name as the project slug; none sends no project; anything else is the slug itself.",
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "recall": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Recall per prompt",
      "description": "Search lumberroom with each prompt and attach new hits for the model. Off by default: each block stays in context for the rest of the session and costs input tokens on every later turn, and weak matches fill the context.",
      "default": false
    },
    "recallExtraProjects": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extra recall projects",
      "description": "Other project slugs to search with each prompt. A bare slug applies everywhere; project=slug1+slug2 applies only in that project, for example lumberroom-cloud=lumberroom.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "recallLimit": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Recall limit",
      "description": "Hits asked for per prompt.",
      "default": 6,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 20
    },
    "recallMaxChars": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Recall block cap",
      "description": "Characters the whole recall block may add (tags, note, hits and write reminder). Each block stays in context for the rest of the session.",
      "default": 4000,
      "min": 500,
      "max": 16000
    },
    "recallMinSimilarity": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Recall similarity floor",
      "description": "Drop hits whose similarity is below this, from 0 to 1. Hits that carry no similarity pass. Prompts under 12 characters skip recall.",
      "default": 0.6,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1
    },
    "recallTimeoutMs": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Recall timeout (ms)",
      "description": "How long a prompt waits for memory_search before going on without it.",
      "default": 2500,
      "min": 500,
      "max": 8000
    },
    "bootstrapTimeoutMs": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Bootstrap timeout (ms)",
      "description": "How long session start waits for context_bootstrap.",
      "default": 5000,
      "min": 5000,
      "max": 8000
    },
    "digestMaxChars": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Digest cap",
      "description": "Characters the digest section of the system prompt may hold.",
      "default": 8000,
      "min": 1000,
      "max": 30000
    },
    "reviewInterval": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Reminder interval",
      "description": "Remind the model to search lumberroom before assuming and to write durable facts after the exchange, every N prompts from you, with recall on or off. 0 turns it off.",
      "default": 8,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100
    },
    "replaceBuiltinMemory": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Replace built-in memory",
      "description": "Drop Claude Code's own memory section and refuse file tools on its memory files.",
      "default": true
    },
    "extractor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extractor",
      "description": "One of off, turn or session-end. off writes nothing on its own. turn extracts every N turns, session-end once as the session ends; both call memory_write directly. Any other value reads as off.",
      "default": "off"
    },
    "extractorModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extractor model",
      "description": "Model alias the extractor runs on.",
      "default": "haiku"
    },
    "ingestToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ingest token",
      "description": "Optional. /lr-import uses the lumberroom CLI's login when this is empty. A bearer with mayIngest overrides it. Kept in secure storage.",
      "sensitive": true
    }
  }
}
